about.intro_heading: Built by a developer who understands what businesses actually need
about.intro_subtitle: The story, the mission, and the person behind MZ Marketing Agency.
about.story_p1: MZ Marketing Agency was founded in August 2024 with a simple observation: too many good businesses were being held back by outdated, slow or non-existent websites. Customers were searching for them online and either finding nothing, or finding something that didn't reflect the quality of the business behind it.
about.story_p2: We set out to close that gap by building modern, responsive, high-converting websites that give businesses of every size a professional home online. From our first project, the focus has stayed the same: clean design, honest communication, and websites that are built to perform, not just look good on a screenshot.
about.story_p3: Today, MZ Marketing Agency works with business owners, medical clinics, law firms and solar companies who want a website that actually earns its place in their marketing, one that loads fast, ranks well, and turns visitors into enquiries.
